title: Concept: Workflow checks out the pull-request head ref (gha)
description: In a gha workflow, ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} places the contributor's own commit on the runner. In a pull_request_target workflow the runner already holds the repository token and any configured secrets, so the first step that executes that commit ends the trust boundary.
applicability: GitHub Actions workflows that comment, label or build from forks; line-based lexical scope.
risk: Repository takeover and secret exfiltration through a pull request; HIGH severity.
